tests.description: An object or array pattern matched against null falls through instead of crashing on a field read.
A nested object pattern whose intermediate field is null falls through. The arm is first, so no earlier check short-circuits the null read away.

An object pattern does not match a number or an array; an array pattern does not match a string or an object. Binder-only patterns have no literal to disagree with, so only the shape check can reject them.
Values of the correct shape still match and still bind.
